spans.s: dussādhya (CII 4), ‘a criminal’; abbreviation of Duḥsādhya-sādhaka, etc.
Duṣṭa-sādhaka (EI 7; CII 4; HD), official designation; ‘the mentor of criminals’; same as Duḥsādhya-sādhanika, Dauḥsā-dhanika, etc. See Ep. Ind., Vol. VII, p. 91.
Duṣṭa-sādhya (EI 21; CII 4), same as dus-sādhya or a criminal; abbreviation of the official designation Duṣṭa-sādhya-sādhanika; same as Duṣṭa-sādhaka, etc.
duṣṭasādhy-ādāya, probably, a tax levied for maintaining the police engaged in suppressing dacoits. Cf. Ghoshal, H. Rev. Syst., p. 254, note. See duḥsādhy-ādāya.
Duṣṭasādhya-sādhanika (Ep. Ind., Vol. XXXV, p. 132), same as Duṣṭa-sādhaka, etc.
Duṣṭa-sāhaṇi (EI 33), same as Duṣṭa-sādhaka, Duṣṭasā-dhya-sādhanika, etc.
